Recommendation summary (preferred):
- Issue a formal credit memo for $15,000 referencing INV-98471 and customer KEST-9921. This is cleaner for audit trails and allows Kestrel to either offset the outstanding invoice or carry the memo forward as a credit.

- Credit memo posting: AR Credit Memo (Account 1200) with memo reference CM-KD-4832-0623
- Contra-revenue for reversal (if recognized): Revenue Reversal (Account 4012) debited, AR/Cash credited depending on payment status
